objective: Audit odds-band return shapes across all standard single-race JRA bet types without optimizing betting policy.

price_layers.D0_terminal_diagnostic: terminal quote selects band; settled payout evaluates; non-actionable
price_layers.D1_actionable: decision-time quote selects band; terminal payout evaluates

inference.estimand: 100 JPY on every eligible ticket in a band

gates.G0: ticket-type-specific provenance, parser, key, payout and timing contract passes
gates.G1: primary shape same direction across discovery/evaluation and Spearman >= 0.70
gates.G2: decision-time effect retains >=50% of terminal diagnostic uplift and CI95 lower exceeds takeout baseline

known_data_constraints.all_ticket_2023: raw layout and timestamp require revalidation
known_data_constraints.forward_2026: 227-column and T-10 coverage differs by ticket type
known_data_constraints.parser: wide, umatan and triple-race ticket layouts are not fully verified

hard_prohibitions: no inferred or proxy odds for missing ticket types
no model probability or Harville ranking
no opening sealed 2024/2025 data for this audit
no actionable claim from terminal-price bands
